[quote=astanir;60301862]Transmissions would be received and sent by most of the Argossian militias. The largest of the groups, Hukuwy-Lukywa (a merger of the Hukuwy-Lukywa tribes towards common cause) would be first the receive the call of cooperation. There would be little debate, with a unanimous agreement to seize this opportunity. Afterall, the Hukuwy and Lukywa tribes have the closest genetic ties to Nordiheim, with little intermingling with the shamans over the years. They would accept the Nordoheimians request for in-person talks and approve them to land aircraft on a makeshift runway to the west of their main village, Muhakai.

The two smaller tribal militias to the east, tshukwa and hgajawk would be a slightly different story. Both their leaderships would deliberate much over the Nordiheimian aid, but would ultimately reach the same conclusion as the Hukuwy-Lukywa. The real problem would arise with the fact that both smaller tribes are currently completely landlocked within the Armed Restoration Fronts territory. However, after a series of encrypted communications between the Hukuwy-Lukywa, the tshukwa and the hgajawk, a plan would be formulated in the spirit of cooperation. All three militias were going to simultaneously advance towards each others territory to create a safe passage towards the Hukuwy-Lukywa. Then, a meeting would be held between all three tribal leaders and the invited Nordiheimian delegates. Additionally, these safe passages could eventually be used to transport equipment and supplies between the tribes. If negotiations were successful, that is.

The tribes inhabiting the two lower islands would be far harder for Nordiheim to contact. Their lack of modern technology and isolationist lifestyle would leave little ways for them to be contacted across such a great distance. This also meant that they are unaware of the ongoing conflict, allowing the Armed restoration front to continue keeping their grip on the islands.[/quote]

Having recived the message that the Hukuwy-Lukywa were open for cooperation, and that the Tshukwa and Hgajawk were willing to have a propper discussion regarding this, the agents and diplomats of Nordiheim would start to make the necessary moves and preparations;

HSF-2B AWAC plains with KJ-6G Kookaburra fighter escorts would be flown in the area, by help of erial refuling, to attain surveilance information that would be shared freely with the Argossian militias.
The fleets of Nordland and Ostland would work together to creat a safe passage way for cargo ships to sail to Astanir with the weapons/equipment and vehicles that the Argossian Militias would need to become stronger,
These weapons/equipment and vehicles would also start to be gathered in propper seriousness, tough some was allready ready in Ostlandian storrages, in tottal the first deliveries would contain enough infantry weapons and equipment to not only supply the militias but also allow them some extra for later use joust incase, but also some vehicles and weapons of more significant value:
- A decent amount of regular trucks and pick-up trucks(they are handy vehicles) with good terain traverse capabilities
- 100x Trukker LT85-5/10 (for cargo/troops but also some tankers for fuel and water)
- 300x Kangaroo MAMIV (of differen variants, tough mostly troop carriers/gun platforms, cargo/munition carriers and tanker variants, all with light armor)
- 50x 105mm L/30 LT Artillery pieces
- 200x MMS-60 LW infantry mortar launchers
- and of course enough fuel, munitions and spare parts for all of this.
Among the infantry gear and weapons would be helmets, bullet proof vests, general tactical gear and camoflague gear relevant for the Astanir enviroment aswell as several types of weapons such as SMG-5B SMGs, SMAR-762 Rifles, MG Mk.2-M Machine guns, AR40-GLM grenade launcher for the rifles and other small arms pluss mines that could be usefull in guerilla style warfare.
There would also be shiped FAF-1 Pillum Anti-tank missile launchers and SA-7 AXS AA MANPADS for when they would meet tanks or aircraft.
The deployment of military advisors and agents would also be offered to the Hukuwy-Lukywa to help them plan and execute their operation to create land conections with the Tshukwa and Hgajawk.

Then there was the problems with contacting the Argossians on the two  lower islands, it seemed that they were either cut off or unaware of what was happening, as such a slightly more direct route would be used to try and establish contact with them;
Elite Shadow Keeper agents, trained in infiltration and operation in hostile territory, would be landed on the islands during the darkness of the nights by submarines to infiltrate the islands and find these tribes so that they could be updated on what was going on and what they could potentialy do with their suport.
To make sure that the tribes would be able to see that they were serious they would ask the Hukuwy-Lukywa how to propperly aproche them in a trustworthy and belivable manner.

That left one more ting to address, the rather isolated enclave towards the center of Astanir, they could most likely be contacted and suplied more propperly trough airdrops and such, but what about possible Astanir air defences still in the other factions hands?
More information would be needed before such operations was executed, as such infiltrators from the Nordland and Olian regions was chosen (as they should be able to blend inn more easely) to be deployed into the territories held by the Astanir National Forces, the Armed Restoration Front and the Democratic Army of Astanir to gather information and data on not only the scope and ability of any anti-air defences that they had and what condition they were inn, but also to know if they could be sabotaged.
In addition there would be sendt extra infiltrators and spies to the territory controlled by the Democratic Army of Astanir to find out more about them and if it would be possible to make them into an allie of the Argossian Militias.

Now Nordiheim would have to simply wait for results to come inn...
